title: Chart units preserve the projective-line transition degree
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $P=\mathbf P^1_k$, $U_i=D_+(x_i)$, $U=U_0\cap U_1$ and $q=x_0/x_1$ [def-sc-p1-standard]. For integers $d,e$ and units $a\in\Gamma(U_0,\mathcal O_P)^\times$, $b\in\Gamma(U_1,\mathcal O_P)^\times$, the equality $a|_U q^d=q^e b|_U$ implies $d=e$.

source.place: Tag 0BXJ, divisors-lemma-Pic-projective-space-UFD, proof specialized to n=1 over a field; TransitionDegreeSeparation

proof.text: Use polyEquivChart on each chart. A polynomial unit over the field is constant, by Polynomial.isUnit_iff, hence a=c_0 and b=c_1 with c_i nonzero. Restriction preserves structural constants.
By injectivity of [lem-sfb-projective-line-overlap-laurent-coordinates], the assumed overlap equality gives C(c_0) T(d)=C(c_1) T(e) in Laurent polynomials.
Apply LaurentPolynomial.degree. The degree_C_mul_T formula gives d=e since c_0 and c_1 are nonzero; this is the uniqueness of Laurent coefficients in [def-weil-laurent-polynomial-ring].

theorem eq_degree_of_chart_units (k : Type u) [Field k] (d e : ℤ)
    (a : Γ(ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k)),
      standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) (⟨0⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)))ˣ)
    (b : Γ(ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k)),
      standardOpen _ (Spec (.of k)) (⟨1⟩ : ULift.{u} (Fin 2)))ˣ)
    (h : Units.map ((ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE inf_le_left).op).hom.toMonoidHom a *
          transitionUnit (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (.of k)) d ⟨0⟩ ⟨1⟩ =
        transitionUnit (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (Spec (.of k)) e ⟨0⟩ ⟨1⟩ *
          Units.map ((ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))).presheaf.map
            (homOfLE inf_le_right).op).hom.toMonoidHom b) : d = e
